steps: Smile so your teeth show.
Your teeth are almost together — just a tiny gap.
The wide tip of your tongue rests behind your bottom teeth.
The middle of your tongue makes a little groove. Cool air runs along it — you can feel it on your hand.
Your throat stays quiet: your hand on your throat does not buzz.
SOUNDS.line: The S sound. Smile so I can see your teeth. Tuck the tip of your tongue behind your bottom teeth. Blow along the middle of your tongue. You get a long hiss, like a snake: sss!

steps: Smile so your teeth show.
Your teeth are almost together — just a tiny gap.
The wide tip of your tongue rests behind your bottom teeth.
The middle of your tongue makes a little groove, and the air runs along it.
Your voice is on: put your hand on your throat — it buzzes like a bee.
SOUNDS.line: The Z sound is like S, but with your voice switched on. Smile. Tuck the tip of your tongue behind your bottom teeth. Put your hand on your throat. It buzzes, like a bee: zzz!

steps: Your lips are a little rounded, pushed forward a bit.
Lift the tip of your tongue towards the bumpy ridge behind your top teeth — close, but not touching.
The sides of your tongue press against your top back teeth.
The air flows gently over your tongue. Nothing taps and nothing shakes.
Your voice is on: rrr, like a growling tiger cub.
SOUNDS.line: The R sound. Round your lips a little. Lift the tip of your tongue towards the bumps behind your top teeth, but do not touch them. Press the sides of your tongue against your back teeth. Now switch on your voice: rrr, like a tiger cub. If it is tricky, do your tongue exercises and it will come!

steps: Your mouth is a little open, lips in a soft smile.
The wide tip of your tongue presses on the bumpy ridge just behind your top teeth.
The middle of your tongue stays low.
The air flows out along both sides of your tongue.
Your voice is on: lll, like a little song.
SOUND_L.line: The L sound. Open your mouth a little. Press the tip of your tongue on the bumps just behind your top teeth. Let the air flow round the sides and switch on your voice: la-la-la!

steps: Your lips are rounded and pushed forward, like a trumpet.
Your teeth are almost together.
Your wide tongue lifts up towards the bumps behind your top teeth, like a little cup.
Warm air runs along the middle of your tongue: shhh, like hushing a sleeping baby.
Your throat stays quiet.
SOUNDS_SH.line: The SH sound. Push your lips forward like a trumpet. Lift your wide tongue like a cup, up towards the bumps behind your top teeth. Blow warm air: shhh, the baby is sleeping!

steps: Your lips are rounded and pushed forward, just like for SH.
Your teeth are almost together.
The tip of your tongue touches the bumps behind your top teeth for a moment, like for T.
Then let go: the air bursts out — t-sh, ch!
Your throat stays quiet: ch-ch-ch, like a little train.
SOUNDS_SH.line: The CH sound is a quick T and SH together. Round your lips. Touch the bumps behind your top teeth with your tongue, then let go with a puff: ch! Like a little train: ch-ch-ch!

CHIST_L: Loo-loo-loo — the lake is lovely blue.
Lee-lee-lee — a lily just for me!
Al-al-al — Sava's dog is called Sal.
Lo-lo-lo — let's float nice and slow.
Loo-loo-loo — the bluebird sings for you.
CHIST_L2: La-la-la — my surfboard glides so far!
Loo-loo-loo — the bishop slides on through.
Lee-lee-lee — Liza the lizard sits by me.
Al-al-al — Sava plays chess with a pal.
Ool-ool-ool — the coach is here, so cool!
Ul-ul-ul — Sava's legs pull, pull, pull!
Il-il-il — Sava plays the piano with skill.
TWIST_L: Lily licks a lemon lolly, lovely lolly, jolly Lily.
Little Lola lost her ladle, looked below the lilac table.
Eleven little ladybirds landed on the lily leaves.
A lazy lion lies in the light, lolling left and lolling right.
Larry's lorry left at eleven, loaded with lollies for Lily and Kevin.
Lots of lovely lilies float on the little blue lake.
Lucy likes yellow, Lola likes lilac, Liza likes lime.
A loud little lamb leaps along the long lane.
Lulu laughed and laughed until all the lollies fell.
TWIST_L2: The bishop glides along the line, the castle rolls level, the king feels fine.
Liza the lizard lies on a log, lapping up sunlight and looking at a frog.
Wave after wave, Sava glides along, balancing lightly, steady and strong.
Black keys, white keys, lovely and loud, lively little melodies please the crowd.
The bicycle rolls and the wheels whirl along, the pedals turn lightly, my legs are strong.
Sava on the skateboard sailed so low, and landed a slick little trick — hello!
CHIST_R: Ra-ra-ra — a rocket flies so far!
Ro-ro-ro — row the boat, here we go!
Ree-ree-ree — Vera's running to the tree!
Ara-ara — Sarah has a red tiara!
Orry-orry — a lorry, don't you worry!
Urry-urry — the bunny's in a hurry!
BOSS_1: Say clearly: la, lo, loo, lee.
BOSS_F: Fast and clear: lion, lemon, lamp, ladder.
MOVES: Stand like you're on a skateboard and do five squats. On each one, say: LA!
Taekwondo stance! Five front kicks. With every kick: LO!
Lie on your back and pedal your legs like a bike ten times: loo-loo-loo!
Surfer pose: balance and hold a long l-l-l-l while you count to ten.
Ten jumps on the spot, like on a scooter. With every jump: LEE!
Move like a chess knight: two steps forward and one to the side. And say: the knight leaps left!
Crawl like a lizard for five steps and say: Liza the lizard is lively!
Play the table with your fingers like a piano and sing: la-la-la-la-la!
Block up and down five times. Up — AL, down — OL!

KP_CHANTS: Sha-sha-sha — shine and sing some more!
Ja-ja-ja — jump and join the song!
Ree-ree-ree — run away, little monster! One, two, three!
VERSES: Listen to my flow, it's light as a leaf,
Lizard Liza and me, we climb up the cliff,
Left on the ledge, then all the way to the top,
My L is loud and my flow will never stop!
Hands on the handlebars, I'm feeling the thrill,
I'm leading the race as I roll down the hill,
A lorry on the left, a cliff on the right,
A slick little turn — and the finish line's in sight!
Yellow belt, blue belt, I'm climbing the scale,
A kick and a block, and I never fail,
The bishop slides slowly, the castle's in line,
Checkmate in two — all the glory is mine!
Ride the blue wave, hold the balance tight,
Sunlight and wind, and it all feels right,
The board's gliding low through the bubbles and foam,
Light as a seagull — I'm sailing back home!
HOOK: La-la-lay — feel how light I go!
